summary: Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature, but no tests were run (per instructions), so everything is unverified. Regenerated expected output: F1 shows elapsed 0:00:37 (foo) and 0:00:36 (bar); foo freezes at 0:01:00 and bar at 0:00:45; bar speed changes to 1 byte/s; bar widths are 25 (F1) and 16 (final frames). Glyph counts were verified by grep; spacing and padding were not verified by running the test. Nothing was committed.
